title: ② AI 비용·토큰 심층
description: ai_usage 도메인 — 어디서/누가/어느 모델이 토큰을 쓰나. 금액은 lab 가격이라 절대값 아닌 랭킹으로. 기간 선택 적용.

panels.title: 비용 일별 (USD)
panels.sql: SELECT dt, round(sum(value),2) AS cost_usd FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE metric='ai_usage.cost_usd' AND dt >= '{{since}}' GROUP BY dt ORDER BY dt

panels.title: 토큰 일별 (입력·출력)
panels.sql: SELECT dt, sum(CASE WHEN metric='ai_usage.tokens_in' THEN value END) AS tokens_in, sum(CASE WHEN metric='ai_usage.tokens_out' THEN value END) AS tokens_out FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE domain='ai_usage' AND dt >= '{{since}}' GROUP BY dt ORDER BY dt

panels.title: 엔티티별 비용 TOP 15
panels.sql: SELECT dims['entity_id'] AS entity, round(sum(value),2) AS cost_usd FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE metric='ai_usage.cost_by_entity' AND dims['entity_id'] IS NOT NULL AND dims['entity_id']<>'' AND dt >= '{{since}}' GROUP BY dims['entity_id'] ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: 모델별 비용
panels.sql: SELECT dims['model'] AS model, round(sum(value),2) AS cost_usd FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE metric='ai_usage.cost_usd' AND dims['model'] IS NOT NULL AND dt >= '{{since}}' GROUP BY dims['model'] ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

panels.title: 엔티티별 trace 수 TOP 15
panels.sql: SELECT dims['entity_id'] AS entity, sum(value) AS traces FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE metric='ai_usage.traces_by_entity' AND dims['entity_id'] IS NOT NULL AND dims['entity_id']<>'' AND dt >= '{{since}}' GROUP BY dims['entity_id'] ORDER BY traces DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: 엔티티별 비용 상세 (TOP 30)
panels.sql: SELECT dims['entity_id'] AS entity, dims['entity_type'] AS type, round(sum(value),2) AS cost_usd FROM polaris.metrics.metric_fact WHERE metric='ai_usage.cost_by_entity' AND dims['entity_id'] IS NOT NULL AND dims['entity_id']<>'' AND dt >= '{{since}}' GROUP BY dims['entity_id'], dims['entity_type'] ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 30
